name: Moon Phase
description: A full-screen daily lunar display for digital signage - tonight's Moon phase and illumination rendered to the exact hemisphere, with the upcoming New, First Quarter, Full and Last Quarter phases. Location is auto-detected by IP or set per screen.
summary: Tonight's Moon phase and the phases ahead.

lat.title: Latitude
lat.description: Optional. Leave empty for Kingston, NY. Sets the hemisphere the Moon is drawn for. Find it in Google Maps: right-click a spot and click the numbers to copy them (the first is latitude).

lng.title: Longitude
lng.description: Optional. Leave empty for Kingston, NY. The second of the two numbers from Google Maps.
